Name: Attitude Data DES
Description: The Attitude Data DES (CSATTA) provides sensor attitude information needed to run the rigorous math model to perform geolocation and mensuration. This DES provides global information for the entire NITF dataset. The Attitude Data DES (CSATTA) can be repeated as necessary if the number of attitude reference points exceeds 9999 in order to contain all attitude data.

DE.Name: File Part Type
DE.Description: This field shall contain the characters DE to edientify the subheader as a data extension.

DESID.Name: Unique DES Type Indentifier
DESID.Description: This field shall contain a valid alphanumeric identifier properly registered with the ISMC.

DESVER.Name: Version of the Data Definition
DESVER.Description: This field shall contain the alphanumeric version number of the use of the tag. The version number is assigned as part of the registraion process.

DECLAS.Name: Data Extension File Security Classification
DECLAS.Description: This field shall contain a valid value representing the classification level of the DES. Valid values are T for Top Secret, S for Secret, C for Confidential, R for Restricted, or U for Unclassified.

DESCLSY.Name: DES Security Classification System
DESCLSY.Description: This field shall contain valid values indicating the national or multinational security system using a geopolitical (country) code digraph to classify the DES. For US producers a geopolitical code (Country Code), as specified by Paragraph 5.1.7e, are used to indicate their national security systems. The designator XN is for classified data generated by a component using NATO security system classification policy marking guidance. The designator XF indicates the de facto classification system policy represented by the security marking indicator NATO/ISAF. These codes were selected to not duplicate codes within the GEC codespace. If this field is populated with all ECS Spaces (0x20), it shall imply that no Security Classification System applies to the DES.

DESCODE.Name: DES Codewords
DESCODE.Description: This field shall contain a word(s) that has been assigned a classification and a classified meaning to safeguard intentions and information regarding a specific classified plan or operation. This codeword may be a cryptonym used to identify sensitive intelligence data. Multiple entries shall be separated by a single ECS space (0x20). If this field is populated with all ECS spaces (0x20), it shall imply that no codewords apply to the DES. Past codeword examples are located in the NITF registry, specified in section C.2.1 Online Resources.

DESCTLH.Name: DES Control and Handling
DESCTLH.Description: This field shall contain valid additional security control and/or handling instructions (caveats) associated with the DES. Values include digraphs found in the NITF Field Control and Handling is an indicator governing the distribution and use of information or material. Such indicators are the subject of intelligence community agreement and are specifically defined in appropriate regulations. Example value Registry, specified in section C.2.1 Online Resources. The digraph may indicate single or multiple caveats. The selection of a relevant caveat(s) is application specific. If this field is populated with all ECS spaces (0x20), it shall imply that no control and handling instructions apply to the DES.

DESREL.Name: DES releasing Instructions
DESREL.Description: This field shall contain a valid list of bare country and/or multilateral entity codes to which countries and/or multilateral entities the DES is authorized for release. Valid entities in the list are one or more bare country codes as specified by Paragraph 5.1.7, separated by a single BCS space (0x20). If this field is populated with all ECS spaces (0x20), it shall imply that no DES release instructions apply.

DESDCTP.Name: DES Declassification Type
DESDCTP.Description: This field shall contain a valid indicator of the type of security declassification or downgrading instructions which apply to the DES. Valid values are DD for declassify on a specific date, DE for declassify upon occurrence of an event, GD for downgrade to a specified level on a specific date, GE for downgrade to a specified level upon occurrence of an event, O for OADR, and X for exempt from automatic declassification. If this field ispopulated with all ECS Spaces (0x20), it shall imply that no DES security declassification or downgrading instructions apply.

DESDCDT.Name: DES Declassification Date
DESDCDT.Description: This field shall indicate the date on which a DES is to be declassified if the value DES DESDCTP field is populated with DD. If this field is populated with all ECS Spaces (0x20), it shall imply that no DES declassification date applies.

DESDCXM.Name: DES Declassification Date
DESDCXM.Description: This field shall indicate the reason the DES is exempt from automatic declassification if the value of the DESDCTP field is populated with X. Valid values are X1 to X8 and 25X1 to 25X9. Values X1 to X8 correspond to the declassification exemptions found in DOD 5200.01-V1, paragraphs 4-202b(1) to (8) for material exempt from the 10-year rule. Values 25X1 to 25X9 correspond to the declassification exemptions found in DOD 5200.01-V1, paragraphs 4-301a(1) to (9) for permanently valuable material exempt from the 25-year declassification system. If this field is populated with all ECS Spaces (0x20), it shall imply that a DES declassification exemption does not apply. Value DNIO is Exempt from automatic declassification and can be declassified only by the Director of National Intelligence (DNI).

DESDG.Name: DES Downgrade
DESDG.Description: This field shall indicate the classification level to which a DES is to be downgraded if the value of the DESDCTP field is populated with GD or GE. Valid values are S for Secret, C for Confidential, R for Restricted. If this field contains an ECS space (0x20), it shall imply that DES security downgrading does not apply.

DESDGDT.Name: DES Downgrade Date
DESDGDT.Description: This field shall indicate the date on which a DES is to be downgraded if the value of the DESDCTP field is populated with GD. If this field is populated with all ECS Spaces (0x20), it shall imply that a DES security downgrading date does not apply.

DESCLTX.Name: DES Classification Text
DESCLTX.Description: This field shall be used to provide additional information about DES classification to include identification of a declassification or downgrading event if the value of the DESDCTP field is populated with DE or GE. It may also be used to identify multiple classification sources and/or any other special handling rules. Values are user-defined free text. If this field is populated with all ECS Spaces (0x20), it shall imply that additional information about DES classification does not apply. This field may also contain overflow values from the DSCTLH or DSREL fields. Consult with the NITF Field Value Registry for overflow population guidance, specified in section C.2.1 Online Resources.

DESCATP.Name: DES Classification Authority Type
DESCATP.Description: This field shall indicate the type of authority used to classify the DES. Valid values are O for original classification authority, D for derivative from a single source, and M for derivative from multiple sources. If this field contains an ECS space (0x20), it shall imply that DES classification authority type does not apply.

DESCAUT.Name: DES Classification Authority
DESCAUT.Description: This field shall identify the classification authority for the DES dependent upon the value of the DESCATP field. Values are user-defined free text which should contain the following information: original classification authority name and position or personal ID if the of the DESCATP field is populated with O; title of the document or security classification guide used to classify the DES if the of the DESCATP field is populated with D; and Deriv-Multiple if the DES classification was derived from multiple sources and the value of the DESCATP field is populated with M. In the latter case, the DES originator will maintain a record of the sources used in accordance with existing security directives. One of the multiple sources may also be identified by the DESCLTX field if desired. If this field is populated with all ECS Spaces (0x20), it shall imply that no DES classification authority applies.

DESCRSN.Name: DES Classification Reason
DESCRSN.Description: This field shall contain values indicating the reason for classifying the DES. Valid values are A to H. These correspond to the reasons for original classification per E.O. 13526, Section 1.5.(a) to (h). If this field contains all ECS Spaces (0x20), it shall imply that no DES classification reason applies.

DESSRDT.Name: DES Security Source Date
DESSRDT.Description: This field shall indicate the date of the source used to derive the classification of the DES. In the case of multiple sources, the date of the most recent source shall be used. If this field is populated with all ECS spaces (code Spaces (0x20), it shall imply that a DES security source date does not apply.

DESCTLN.Name: DES Security Control Number
DESCTLN.Description: This field shall contain a valid security control number associated with the DES. The format of the security control number shall be in accordance with the regulations governing the appropriate security channel(s). If this field is populated with all ECS Spaces (0x20), it shall imply that no DES security control number applies.

DESSHL.Name: User-defined Subheader Length
DESSHL.Description: This field shall contain a valid security control number associated with the DES. The format of the security control number shall be in accordance with the regulations governing the appropriate security channel(s). If this field is populated with all ECS Spaces (0x20), it shall imply that no DES security control number applies.

ATT_TYPE.Name: Type of Attitude
ATT_TYPE.Description: This field represents the type of attitude data being provided. ORIGINAL = Original attitude data from the sensor, and REFINDED = Smoothed attitude data basesd upon Provider processing.

DT_ATT.Name: Time interval between reference points
DT_ATT.Description: This field represents the time interval between attitude reference points.

DATE_ATT.Name: Number of attitude reference points
DATE_ATT.Description: This field represents the day at the first attitude reference point. The format of the field is YYYYMMDD.

T0_ATT.Name: UTC of first attitude reference point
T0_ATT.Description: This field represents the time of the first attitude reference point  The forrmat of the field is HHMMSS.mmmmmm.

NUM_ATT.Name: Number of Attitude Reference Points
NUM_ATT.Description: This field represents the number of attitude reference points throughout the scan interval.

ATT_Q1.Name: Quaternion Q1 of Attitude Reference Point
ATT_Q1.Description: This field represents the attitude quaternion Q1 in the ECEF coordinate system.

ATT_Q2.Name: Quaternion Q2 of Attitude Reference Point
ATT_Q2.Description: This field represents the attitude quaternion Q2 in the ECEF coordinate system.

ATT_Q3.Name: Quaternion Q3 of Attitude Reference Point
ATT_Q3.Description: This field represents the attitude quaternion Q3 in the ECEF coordinate system.

ATT_Q4.Name: Quaternion Q4 of Attitude Reference Point
ATT_Q4.Description: This field represents the attitude quaternion Q4 in the ECEF coordinate system.

SHAPE_USE.Name: Shapefile Use
SHAPE_USE.Description: This field indicateds what the shapefile represents.

SHAPE_CLASS.Name: Type of shapes contained within this Shapefile
SHAPE_CLASS.Description: This field indicateds what the shapefile represents.

CC_SOURCE.Name: Source sensor(s) for determining cloud cover (appears only if SHAPE_USE is CLOUD_SHAPES)
CC_SOURCE.Description: This field indicateds the sensor(s) for determining cloud cover.

SHAPE1_NAME.Name: Name of the first file in the Shapefile
SHAPE1_NAME.Description: This field indicates the name of the first file in the Shapefile.

SHAPE1_START.Name: Start location in bytes of the first file, expressed as an offset in the DES User-Defined Data
SHAPE1_START.Description: This field indicates the start location in bytes of the first file, expressed as an offset in the DES User-Defined Data.

SHAPE2_NAME.Name: Name of second fiel in the Shapefile
SHAPE2_NAME.Description: This field indicates the name of the second file in the Shapefile.

SHAPE2_START.Name: Start location in bytes of the second file, expressed as an offset in the DES User-Defined Data
SHAPE2_START.Description: This field indicates the start location in bytes of the second file, expressed as an offset in the DES User-Defined Data.

SHAPE3_NAME.Name: Name of third file in the Shapefile
SHAPE3_NAME.Description: This field indicates the name of the third file in the Shapefile.

SHAPE3_START.Name: Start location in bytes of the third file, expressed as an offset in the DES User-Defined Data
SHAPE3_START.Description: This field indicates the start location in bytes of the third file, expressed as an offset in the DES User-Defined Data.
